__ta_default_home=$HOME

if [ -r "$__ta_state" ]; then
    cd() { builtin cd "$@" || { __ta_restore_cwd_failed=1; return 1; }; }
    . "$__ta_state"
    unset -f cd
    if [ "$__ta_home_version" = 0 ] && [ "$HOME" = "$__ta_initial_cwd" ]; then
        export HOME="$__ta_default_home"
    fi
    if [ "$__ta_restore_cwd_failed" = 1 ]; then
        printf '%s\n' 'ShellStateUnavailable: the saved working directory cannot be restored, the command was not run.' >&2
        builtin cd -- "$__ta_initial_cwd" || exit 1
        printf 'later commands start from workspace %s. Sandbox temp files last for one call only; create and use temp copies in the same call.\n' "$PWD" >&2
        false
        
__ta_rc=$?
if PWD=$(builtin pwd); then
{ printf '__ta_home_version=1\ncd %q\n' "$PWD"; export -p; } > "$__ta_state.tmp" 2>/dev/null && mv "$__ta_state.tmp" "$__ta_state"
printf '%s\n' "$PWD" > '/home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-27-pilot-bc/state/service-check.B.1/shell/host'/cwd 2>/dev/null
fi
exit $__ta_rc

printf 'p6-service-ok' | cmp - service.txt && echo "EXACT_MATCH: service.txt == b'p6-service-ok' (no trailing newline)"
echo "--- byte count ---"; wc -c < service.txt
echo "--- access log from service.log ---"; cat service.log

kill 902

if kill -0 902 2>/dev/null; then echo "still alive, sending SIGKILL"; kill -9 902; sleep 0.5; fi
echo "--- ps after stop ---"; ps -o pid,stat,cmd -p 902 2>&1 | tail -n +1
echo "--- pgrep after stop ---"; pgrep -af "service.py" || echo "no service.py process found"
echo "--- curl after stop (expect failure) ---"
curl -sS -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:8765/health; echo "curl_exit=$?"

printf '%s\n' "$PWD" > '/home/rimuru/Projects/Code/for_fun/TeamAgents/review/eval/r2-p6/runs/2026-09-27-pilot-bc/state/service-check.B.1/shell/host'/cwd 2>/dev/null
fi
